ev.q: Sarah & Duck is a British animated children's television series
primarily targeted at 4 to 6 year old children
The show is about the friendship of a wide-eyed girl, her pet duck
Each five-minute story is told with humour and joy
primarily targeted at 4 to 6 year old children
Sarah and Duck laugh and sing, and play all kinds of games with their friends
A total of 120 episodes have been commissioned
